summary: This note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on the Lake-class patrol vessel, a class of patrol vessels. It states that the vessels were built in 1974 for the Royal New Zealand Navy by the British boat builder Brooke Marine. The note contains no further detail on design, service history or fate.
one_line: The Lake-class patrol vessels were built in 1974 by Brooke Marine for the Royal New Zealand Navy.
key_facts: The Lake-class patrol vessel was a class of patrol vessels.
